purpose: Freeze the final evidence-to-claim mapping after Task15M execution validation without performing confirmation-outcome analysis.

claims.public_statement: PF-ERI is a post-retrieval pair-level evidence-admission layer for human reviewability, not an identity-assignment system or replacement descriptor.
claims.manuscript_treatment: May be stated as the project definition.

claims.public_statement: In the prospectively governed independent Task15I development sample, P5 passed the frozen development screen against P3 and was frozen with lambda 100.
claims.manuscript_treatment: Report only as a development-stage qualification result.

claims.public_statement: Task15L completed the prespecified apparent probability calibration for frozen P3 and P5 without model reselection or refitting the original models.
claims.manuscript_treatment: Report as calibration completion, not independent performance validation.

claims.public_statement: The authoritative Task15M external execution passed run, validation, coverage, descriptor, and artifact-integrity checks.
claims.manuscript_treatment: Use the exact status PASS_TASK15M_EXECUTION_VALIDATION and retain its execution-only boundary.

claims.public_statement: The historical 400-pair v1 model, reliability, and routing results remain exploratory provenance and are not PF-ERI v2 confirmation evidence.
claims.manuscript_treatment: Keep in the locked v1 manuscript or label explicitly as historical exploratory evidence.

claims.public_statement: P5 superiority over P3 on independent confirmation outcomes has not been established.
claims.manuscript_treatment: Do not report a confirmation Brier increment, interval, superiority decision, or external predictive-performance result.

claims.public_statement: No PF-ERI identity-accuracy, mAP, MRR, top-k, false-match, or automatic identity-assignment claim is authorized.
claims.manuscript_treatment: State the boundary explicitly wherever reviewability is discussed.

claims.public_statement: Deployment utility and workflow efficiency have not been established under the v2 cost and confirmation contract.
claims.manuscript_treatment: Do not upgrade historical routing simulations into a v2 deployment claim.

claims.public_statement: PF-ERI v2 is not scientifically complete because independent confirmation-outcome performance and remaining Workstream 05 exit analyses are unresolved.
claims.manuscript_treatment: Keep the v2 manuscript under a bounded integration lock.

prohibited_actions: calculate confirmation Brier or other outcome-performance metrics
cite the superseded wrong-source confirmation analysis
describe PASS_TASK15M_EXECUTION_VALIDATION as external predictive validation
merge historical v1 numerical results into v2 confirmation claims
